messages:
Priya: Heads-up — Fulcrum private VPC deploy is scheduled for Fri 02:00–03:30 UTC. This is the customer-facing cutover (no DB schema changes). Please confirm owners for each area and that rollback playbook is staged. Link to runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/fulcrum-cutover :spiral_calendar:
Jorge: I can own infra/route cutover + autoscaler checks. Will be on call from 01:45 UTC. My checklist: verify LB weights, BGP sessions, and pre-warm endpoints.
Liam: I'll take smoke verification and logs. Plan to run smoke script, tail logs, and validate latencies for the first 5 minutes. Ping me when traffic is shifted.
Amanda: I'll coordinate the private-control-plane work and confirm image tags are pinned. Quick note: the canary policy is 5% for 10 minutes then 50% for 15. Confirming canary job is green on staging.
Sung: Networking: Fulcrum ops have confirmed the firewall rules. Need the exact jumpbox IP we hand to them. @Priya — can you confirm the outbound IP from our side so they can whitelist?
Priya: Jumpbox IP is 18.203.45.12. I'll DM the Ops contact with the public key. CustomerOps, can you confirm they have KMS access and cert bundle? @CustomerOps
CustomerOps: Confirmed — KMS key is in place, cert bundle auto-rotates. We need bit more lead time if they want HSM-backed keys, though.
Priya: Not HSM for this window, we good.
Jorge: A few preflight commands I'll run 30m before cutover:
```bash
# LB health
curl -I https://fulcrum-api.private/health
# KV cache confirm
redis-cli -h cache-1.pvt PING
``` 
If any return non-200 / PONG mismatch I'll abort.
Liam: Smoke test plan (short):
- hit /health and /v1/predict for a couple of routes
- validate 95th latency < 250ms
- sanity check 5 sample prompts
I'll post results as quick bullets.
Amanda: FYI, rollback toggle is wired to the route-weight script. If needed we run:
```bash
# rollback to previous pool
./route-weight --service fulcrum --set old-pool=100
``` 
This will be in the runbook under "rollback-commands".
Priya: Who's taking post-cutover monitoring for the first 30m (errors, 5xx spikes, token-cost anomalies)?
Liam: I'll cover first 30m. Jorge can take the next hour.
Jorge: I'll also have a lightweight probe watching KV miss rate and queue depth.
DevOpsBot: Scheduled maintenance window created: Fulcrum Private VPC — Fri 02:00–03:30 UTC. Pager rule: eng-platform-oncall -> Jorge. Reminder 30m before.
Amanda: Code review/gate: all PRs for this change are merged and green except one minor lint that I fixed. No migrations, but a config toggle needs to be present. Confirmed in prod config: `enable_new_cache=false` for this rollout.
Priya: Quick ask — will this require a db read replica failover? I thought Fulcrum wants a quick DNS TTL update.
Jorge: No DB failover. We will do a weighted LB cutover + announce via transit gateway. DNS TTL is 60s for the service.
Sung: Re: transit gateway — we've coordinated with customer VPN team. They'll do a short BGP withdraw/announce at the start. Please be ready to rollback if route propagation stalls >4m.
Liam: If anything looks off I'll run a targeted canary rollback for the 5% cohort first, then full rollback if needed.
Priya: Last-minute checklist for everyone (copy into runbook):
- [ ] Jumpbox and keys distributed (Priya)
- [ ] Infra owner on call (Jorge)
- [ ] Smoke owner (Liam)
- [ ] Control plane/app deploy owner (Amanda)
- [ ] Network confirm (Sung)
- [ ] CustomerOps confirm KMS/certs (CustomerOps)
- [ ] Rollback commands verified (Amanda)
Amanda: I'll update the runbook now and attach the exact commands. ETA 10m.
Jorge: Small note — metric alerts will be suppressed for the window except for critical p50/p95 latency and 5xx > 1%.
Priya: Thanks. If anyone can't make the window, say now so we can shift. Otherwise we'll proceed with the Fri slot. :thumbsup:
CustomerOps: Fulcrum ops team will be online during the window and reachable on their slack channel. They've asked for a quick smoke report at +5m and +20m.
Liam: Copy — I'll post the +5m/+20m bullets here.
Amanda: Runbook updated: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/fulcrum-cutover#playbook — includes rollback commands and verification steps.
Priya: Perfect. I'll send the calendar invite and the final confirmation on Thurs EOD. Thanks everyone! :rocket:
